slug: 梦中强吻女帝被找上门了怎么办
content_zh:
招摇山，万妖宫。
夜浓如墨，乌云盖顶，暴雨滂沱。
江晨站在山巅悬崖上，眯着眼睛打量对面的翠衣女子：“不愧是万妖宫主，好强的压迫感！这一身的神器，都是绝版装备吧？”
翠衣女子漂浮在半空，一双晶莹如玉的赤足踩在黑色莲台上，居高临下地俯瞰江晨，绝美面容上露出一抹轻蔑笑容：“你怕了？”
即便是一副讥诮不屑的神情，但放在她那张白瓷玉偶一般精致无瑕的俏脸上，却具备着勾魂摄魄的魅惑和妖艳。
她就是万妖宫主，这个游戏中的最终boss。
她的修为已是传说中的十阶妖仙之境，举手投足间，就能引起虚空震动，道韵流转。
她周围环绕着一圈朦胧的青色光晕，倾盆大雨落在她头顶五尺外就被无形力量蒸干，无法淋湿她半分。
反观江晨，被大雨淋得像落汤鸡一般，相比之下颇为狼狈。
“怕？我怎么可能会怕！如果不是为了你这身装备，我还懒得跑这么远！”江晨捋了捋湿漉漉的长发，舞了个剑花，摆出一个帅气的造型，“我只是可惜你这件极品衣服，就算爆出来了，我也穿不上！”
万妖宫主面上闪过一抹羞怒之色，她慢慢眯起眼睛，嘴角的冷笑也多了几分危险的意味：“哦，你想抢本宫的衣服？”
“不光是衣服，还有耳环，手镯，项链，玉佩，法宝……你身上所有的东西，我全都要！”
“好，很好，本宫欣赏你的坦诚和贪婪。”万妖宫主的语气中蕴含着冰冷的杀机，“你既然这么想要，那就放马过来吧！”
双方摆开架势，战至一处。
这一战直打得昏天暗地，日月无光，连天空的乌云都被两人激斗的余波冲散，露出漆黑的夜空。
双方各施手段，从一开始的远程法术对轰，到剑气互砍，再到贴身肉搏，最后拳脚相抵，比拼力气。
江晨终于压制住了万妖宫主，却也累得气喘吁吁，汗流浃背。
“哈哈！哈哈哈！论美貌，我不如你；论打架，你不如我！万妖宫主，你输了！”江晨得意地笑起来，“老子一身强十六的史诗装备，你以为是好看的吗？这个全服首杀，我拿定了！”
“胜负还早呢！”万妖宫主面上毫无惊慌之色，只有宝石般的眼眸里闪过一丝疑惑，“不过，你说的‘强石榴’是什么意思？‘全服首杀’又是什么？”
江晨摇摇头：“你一个npc，跟你说你也不懂。”

他正要抡起拳头再战，鼻尖忽然嗅到一阵淡淡的幽香，不由为之一怔。
这幽香，是万妖宫主身上的香味？
现在的vr游戏设备这么高级吗？连嗅觉都能模拟出来？
那……如果我亲她一下，会是什么感觉？
这个古怪的念头刚从江晨心中泛起，就一发不可收拾，如野火一般蔓延到全身，催促他快点行动。
反正只是一场游戏，一个npc。
人生苦短，何妨一试！
江晨下定决心，朝万妖宫主露出古怪的笑容：“妖女，我要你助我修行！”
“嗯？”万妖宫主眨了眨眼睛，没明白他这句话的意思。
趁万妖宫主还在迷惑之际，江晨忽然俯下身子，凑近脸颊，朝她嘴唇上狠狠亲了一口。
“mua~”
冰冰凉凉，又有些香甜。
这感觉，好真实！
万妖宫主宝石般的双眼，瞬间瞪得老大，全身毛发竖立，肌肉都绷紧了，应激而发的力量刹时将江晨掀飞出去。
“你——你这无礼的登徒子！找死！”
万妖宫主怒叫一声，爆发出惊天动地的气势，朝江晨扑来。
江晨跌下悬崖，沿途留下一串大笑：“哈哈哈哈！好甜的味道！”
万妖宫主怒不可遏，挟裹着凄厉的风声，沿着崖壁紧追而下。
content_en:
Zhaoyao Mountain, Palace of Ten Thousand Demons.
The night was as thick as ink, with dark clouds covering the sky and heavy rain.
Jiang Chen stood on the cliff at the top of the mountain, squinting his eyes and looking at the woman in green clothes opposite him: "As expected of the Master of the Palace of Ten Thousand Demons, what a strong sense of oppression! The artifacts in this body are all out-of-print equipment, right?"
The woman in green clothes floated in the air, her bare feet as clear as jade stepped on the black lotus platform, and she looked down at Jiang Chen. A scornful smile appeared on her beautiful face: "Are you afraid?"
Even though she had a sarcastic and disdainful expression, her pretty face, as delicate and flawless as a white porcelain jade doll, possessed a captivating charm and coquettishness.
She is the Lord of the Ten Thousand Demons Palace, the final boss in this game.
Her cultivation level has reached the legendary tenth-level demon fairy realm. With every move of her hands and feet, she can cause the void to vibrate and the Taoist rhyme to flow.
She was surrounded by a hazy cyan halo, and the heavy rain fell five feet away from her head and was evaporated by invisible forces, unable to get her even wet.
On the other hand, Jiang Chen was soaked in the heavy rain and looked quite embarrassed in comparison.
"Afraid? How could I be afraid! If it weren't for your equipment, I wouldn't have bothered to run so far!" Jiang Chen smoothed his wet long hair, danced a sword flower, and put on a handsome pose, "I'm just a pity that even if your top-notch clothes were exposed, I wouldn't be able to wear them!"
A look of shame and anger flashed across the face of the Master of the Palace of Ten Thousand Demons. She slowly narrowed her eyes, and the sneer at the corner of her mouth became a little more dangerous: "Oh, you want to steal my clothes?"
"Not only clothes, but also earrings, bracelets, necklaces, jade pendants, magic weapons... I want everything on you!"
"Okay, very good. I appreciate your frankness and greed." The tone of the Lord of the Ten Thousand Demons Palace contained cold murderous intent, "Since you want it so much, then come here!"
The two sides took up positions and fought to the same point.
The battle continued in darkness, with no light from the sun or the moon. Even the dark clouds in the sky were washed away by the aftermath of the fierce battle between the two, revealing the dark night sky.
Both sides used their own methods, from the long-range magic attack at the beginning, to slashing each other with swords, to hand-to-hand combat, and finally to fighting with fists and feet to compete in strength.
Jiang Chen finally suppressed the Ten Thousand Demons Palace Master, but he was still panting and sweating from exhaustion.
"Haha! Hahaha! In terms of beauty, I am not as good as you; in terms of fighting, you are not as good as me! Master of the Palace of Ten Thousand Demons, you lose!" Jiang Chen smiled proudly, "I am wearing powerful epic equipment, do you think it looks good? This is the first kill in the server, I'm sure of it!"
"It's still too early to win or lose!" There was no panic on the face of the Lord of the Ten Thousand Demons Palace, only a trace of doubt flashed in his gem-like eyes, "But, what do you mean by 'strong pomegranate'? And what is 'first kill in the server'?"
Jiang Chen shook his head: "You are an NPC. Even if I tell you, you don't understand."
He was about to raise his fist and fight again, when he suddenly smelled a faint fragrance at the tip of his nose, and he couldn't help but be startled.
Is this fragrance the fragrance of the Lord of the Ten Thousand Demons Palace?
Are current VR gaming equipment so advanced? Can even the sense of smell be simulated?
So...what would it feel like if I kissed her?
As soon as this strange idea emerged in Jiang Chen's mind, it got out of control and spread throughout his body like wildfire, urging him to act quickly.
Anyway, it’s just a game, an NPC.
Life is short, why not give it a try!
Jiang Chen made up his mind and showed a strange smile to the Master of the Ten Thousand Demons Palace: "Demon girl, I want you to help me practice!"
"Huh?" The Master of the Palace of Ten Thousand Demons blinked, not understanding what he meant.
While the Master of the Palace of Ten Thousand Demons was still confused, Jiang Chen suddenly leaned down, approached her cheek, and kissed her hard on the lips.
"mua~"
Bingbing is cool and a little sweet.
This feeling is so real!
The jewel-like eyes of the Lord of the Ten Thousand Demons Palace suddenly widened, the hair on his body stood on end, and his muscles tightened. The force of the stress instantly overwhelmed Jiang Chen.Fly away.
"You - you rude scoundrel! Looking for death!"
The Master of the Palace of Ten Thousand Demons screamed angrily, bursting out with an earth-shattering momentum, and rushed towards Jiang Chen.
Jiang Chen fell off the cliff, leaving a string of laughter along the way: "Hahahaha! It tastes so sweet!"
The Master of the Palace of Ten Thousand Demons was furious and chased down the cliff with the shrill sound of the wind.
